The '''Agricultural Complex''' on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]] was owned by [[Demma Moll]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Moll and her [[Kea Moll's father|partner]] raised their daughter, [[Kea Moll|Kea]] on the farm. The [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] sought to take possession of the farm.
